drug_policy: no drug-level holdout: every evaluated pair has two drugs that are seen during training; the strict unseen-drug setting is the separate cold-start experiment

kg_policy.combination: training positives of the fold only

negative_policy: one negative per positive, stratified by the number of drug-target interactions, sampled without replacement and disjoint across the splits
note: counts are the numbers actually present in the committed pair metadata, i.e. after the knowledge-graph availability filter
